mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.userName, u.account, u.phone, u.email, u.balance, u.avatarPath, u.level, u.vipCreateTime, u.vipDuration, u.createTime, u.uploadTime, u.uploadBackground, u.uploadGoods, u.updateAvatar, u.`delete`, u.`describe`, vc.levelName AS vipLevelName, GREATEST(0, DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(u.vipCreateTime, INTERVAL u.vipDuration DAY), NOW())) AS vipRemainingTime, vc.maxAddressQuantity, vc.monthlyUpdateGoods, vc.monthlyUpdateAvatar, vc.monthlyUpdateBackground, vc.maxCartQuantity, vc.maxGoodsQuantity, vc.maxAiQuantity FROM user u LEFT JOIN vipconfig vc ON u.level = vc.level
AND u.id = #{entity.id}

SELECT a.id, a.userId, a.addressId, a.country, a.province, a.city, a.county, a.detail, a.createTime, a.`delete`, u.userName FROM address a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.userId = u.id
a.`delete` = 0 AND a.userId = #{entity.userId}

SELECT c.id AS cartId, g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.describe, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.`delete`, c.quantity, u.userName, u.avatarPath AS merchantAvatar, u.id AS merchantId, CONCAT(ad.country, ad.province, ad.city, ad.county, ad.detail) AS address FROM cart c LEFT JOIN goods g ON c.goodId = g.id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN address ad ON g.addressId = ad.id
AND c.userId = #{entity.userId}

SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.`describe`, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.`delete`, u.userName, u.avatarPath AS merchantAvatar, u.id AS merchantId, CONCAT(ad.country, ad.province, ad.city, ad.county, ad.detail) AS address, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS inCart, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.quantity ELSE 0 END AS cartQuantity FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN address ad ON g.addressId = ad.id LEFT JOIN cart c ON c.goodId = g.id AND c.userId = #{entity.userId}
g.launch = 1 AND g.`delete` = 0 AND u.userName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.userName}, '%') AND g.goodsName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.goodsName}, '%') AND g.goodsPrice >= #{entity.priceMin} AND g.goodsPrice <= #{entity.priceMax}

SELECT t.id, t.orderId, t.userId, t.goodId, t.quantity, t.originAddress, t.currentAddress, t.targetAddress, t.createTime, t.payTime, t.cancelTime, t.finishTime, t.`delete`, m.userName AS merchantName, g.goodsName, g.goodsPrice, (g.goodsPrice * t.quantity) AS totalPrice FROM trade t LEFT JOIN goods g ON t.goodId = g.id LEFT JOIN user m ON g.userId = m.id
t.`delete` = 0 AND t.userId = #{entity.userId} AND m.userName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.merchantName}, '%') AND g.goodsName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.goodsName}, '%') AND t.createTime >= #{entity.createTimeStart} AND t.createTime <= #{entity.createTimeEnd}

SELECT level, levelName, maxAddressQuantity, monthlyUpdateGoods, monthlyUpdateAvatar, monthlyUpdateBackground, maxCartQuantity, maxGoodsQuantity, maxAiQuantity, price, vipDuration, createTime FROM vipconfig ORDER BY level ASC

SELECT vt.id, vt.userId, vt.level, vt.money, vt.num, vt.createTime, vt.num AS quantity, vc.vipDuration AS addedTime, DATE_ADD(u.vipCreateTime, INTERVAL u.vipDuration DAY) AS vipExpireTime FROM viptrade vt LEFT JOIN user u ON vt.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN vipconfig vc ON vt.level = vc.level
AND vt.userId = #{entity.userId}

SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.`describe`, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.`delete`, u.userName, u.avatarPath AS merchantAvatar, u.id AS merchantId, CONCAT(ad.country, ad.province, ad.city, ad.county, ad.detail) AS address, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS inCart, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.quantity ELSE 0 END AS cartQuantity FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN address ad ON g.addressId = ad.id LEFT JOIN cart c ON c.goodId = g.id AND c.userId = #{userId} WHERE g.launch = 1 AND g.`delete` = 0 AND g.id IN
#{id}
SELECT u.userName, u.`describe`, u.level, vc.levelName FROM user u LEFT JOIN vipconfig vc ON u.level = vc.level WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.`delete` = 0
SELECT imagePath, sequence FROM background WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY sequence ASC

SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.`describe`, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, CONCAT(ad.country, ad.province, ad.city, ad.county, ad.detail) AS address FROM goods g LEFT JOIN address ad ON g.addressId = ad.id WHERE g.userId = #{userId} AND g.launch = 1 AND g.`delete` = 0 ORDER BY g.id DESC
